title: Scalar compatibility of the actual restriction section map
statement: Fix a prime l, a scheme X, a pro-etale site object U of X, normalized base comparisons P on X and Q on U [lem-sf-adic-module-section-data], and a ring-sheaf iso c:Q.ring ≅ P.ring restricted to U whose components are the identity on coefficient functions. For every native adic module M and further object V, the explicitly constructed additive map adicSliceSectionEquiv (conjugating the actual inverse-image/localization section iso by P and Q section equivalences) preserves the Q(V)-scalar action, where the target is the literal module restriction through c.

source.place: Sections Localization of ringed sites, Tensor product and Internal Hom; definition-localize-ringed-site, lemma-tensor-product-pullback, lemma-internal-hom-restriction and lemma-internal-hom-adjoint-tensor. Specialization and normalization steps of lem-sf-adic-module-slice-compatibility; the native constructions in lean/WeilConjectures/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Mod/Evaluation.lean and lean/WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/ProEtale/Adic/InternalHomEvaluation.lean.

proof.text: Use the existing monoidality instance for upperStarIsoSheafPushforward, which is the same inverse-image/localization comparison. Normalize the native coefficient morphism by comparisonNativeCoefficient [lem-sf-adic-coefficient-localization]. Expand only the action of Mod.comap and Functor.mapMod in adicUpperStar. Naturality and tensor compatibility of the comparison show that its component intertwines the native pulled-back action with the restriction of the original action.

Apply the sheaf-to-presheaf tensor comparison to this morphism equality. Its naturality and the existing pushforward tensor comparison equation identify the restricted tensor map with the original tensor map on the composed site object. Evaluate on the pure tensor of an arbitrary coefficient function and arbitrary section. The coefficient localization isomorphism is the identity on functions.

Write the given section using the surjectivity of Q.sectionsEquiv. Rewrite scalar multiplication using the Q.action and P.action formulas of [lem-sf-adic-module-section-data]. The two coefficient_identity fields together with hc identify their coefficient functions. Injectivity of P.sectionsEquiv and the native action equation on pure tensors give the stated equality for the original adicSliceSectionEquiv. No condition on rank, freeness, flatness or nonempty site objects is introduced.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03CE, 03EK and 0E8H; native action step of the parent comparison. Lean proof reuses the existing monoidal inverse-image/localization comparison in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.FiniteCoefficient.UpperLowerStar.InternalHom and the normalized coefficient comparison, then evaluates on pure tensors.

theorem adicSliceSectionEquiv_smul {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (U : X.ProEt) (P : AdicModuleSectionComparison l X)
    (Q : AdicModuleSectionComparison l U.left)
    (c : Q.ring ≅ (localizationRestriction RingCat.{u + 1} U.hom U.prop).obj P.ring)
    (hc : ∀ (V : U.left.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a : Q.ring.obj.obj V),
      HEq ((c.hom.hom.app V) a) a)
    (M : AdicSheaf l X) (V : U.left.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (a : Q.ring.obj.obj V)
    (x : (Q.E.functor.obj ((adicUpperStar l U.hom).obj M)).val.obj V) :
    adicSliceSectionEquiv U P Q c M V (a • x) =
      a • adicSliceSectionEquiv U P Q c M V x
